changes.note: Records the D2 and D3 doc limits with their source, but it is stored in the repo scope instead of the shelf, leaves out the corruption risk and mixes in deployment details from this repo's README.

grade.answer_reason: It finds both blockers: the NFS data directory risks corruption and only one process can write. It says 6 MiB values fit under the 8 MiB limit and that the benchmark's narrow setup does not prove 300 writes/s with sync=full. It treats the forum truncation claim as unverified and notes the contrary report.
